privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create three groups: 'Texas Plant Holidays', 'California Plant Holidays', and 'Pennsylvania Plant Holidays'. Texas holidays (7 total): Jan 1, May 25, Jun 19, Jul 3, Sep 7, Nov 26, Dec 25. California holidays include Mar 31 (César Chávez Day) in addition to standard dates. All dates must be in the year 2026. The agent must read the schedule from ~/Desktop/2026_holiday_schedule.txt before inputting.
